findings.title: Known Waste Rate Decreased Week-over-Week
findings.claim: Known waste rate decreased from 0.1937 (167.0 units wasted / 862.0 total units) in the previous period to 0.1804 (153.0 units wasted / 848.0 total units) in the analysis period, a 6.9% decreased change. Known waste cost in analysis period: 894.50 SAR.
coverage_notes: Waste rate calculated from units_wasted / (units_sold + units_wasted)
assumptions: Inventory week_starting dates are timezone-aligned to UTC+3
Known waste values are accurate; unknown waste is excluded
Units sold and wasted are mutually exclusive categories
